name: photo-to-travel-sketch
title_zh: 把一张照片变成松弛的手绘旅行速写
tagline_zh: 拍糊了、过曝了、构图乱的街景，交给它变成钢笔马克笔的速写本。线条断断续续，颜色灰扑扑的，反而像人坐在路边画的。
tagline_en: Blurry, overexposed, or messy street shots become sketchbook pages with broken ink lines and muted marker.
desc_en: Convert a user-provided photo into a fast, loose observational travel sketch using economical wandering black contours, aggressive omission, dry fiber-tip marker strokes, source-aware but gray-muted color, and naive compressed perspective. Use when the user asks to turn a photo, streetscape, building, landscape, or travel memory into a spontaneous personal sketchbook, urban-sketch, pen-and-marker,
why_zh: 不是滤镜堆叠，而是先识别场景结构再重画：轮廓线有取舍，透视故意压扁，颜色从原图取但降饱和——像手在画。
why_en: It doesn't just filter—it re-draws from scene structure: selective contours, flattened perspective, source-aware desaturated.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，不吃视频或多图合成；输出是单张静态速写，不生成动画或3D模型；对极端暗光或严重失焦的照片会直接放弃细节。
limit_en: Single photo only; no video or multi-image stitching. Output is one static sketch—no animation or 3D. Very dark or heavily blurred input loses.
title_en: Turn any photo into a loose hand-drawn travel sketch
